Net read: global backdrop is neutral-to-mildly-cautious for PSX today -- no equity tailwind, a firming gold/oil bid, and a domestically driven rupee wobble.
drivers: SBP FX reserves rose $13mn to $17.04bn for the week ended 2026-07-31 (a second straight modest weekly gain after three prior weeks of decline), verified this run; total liquid reserves (SBP + banks) stood at $22.47bn, import cover ~2.5 months (https://tribune.com.pk/story/2622492/sbp-reserves-rise-13m)

T-bill auction 2026-08-05: 6M cutoff eased to 11.70% (from 11.79% on 2026-07-23), 12M to 11.95% (from 11.99%), Rs939.11bn raised against Rs2.29tr bid -- strong demand and a slight short-end yield pullback ahead of the 2026-09-14 MPC, verified this run (https://mettisglobal.news/SBP-raises-Rs939bn-through-MTB-Auction-62425)

PIB auction 2026-08-04: 2Y bids rejected outright, 10Y cutoff firmed to 12.30% (from 12.14%) and 15Y to 12.49% (from 12.285%), Rs859.88bn raised -- a steepening long end suggests the market is pricing rate-hold persistence/duration premium rather than imminent easing, verified this run (https://mettisglobal.news/SBP-raises-Rs860bn-in-Fixed-Rate-PIB-Auction-62390)

SBP held its policy rate at 11.5% on 2026-07-27 (second consecutive FY27 hold); next MPC confirmed for 2026-09-14, reconfirmed this run with no new decision since (https://www.brecorder.com/news/40425595)

PBS headline CPI for July 2026 confirmed at 9.2% YoY (down from June's 11.1%, flattered by a low 4.1% July-2025 base), reconfirmed this run; food/beverages +10.6% YoY the largest contributor, urban 8.7% vs rural 9.9% (https://www.app.com.pk/business/headline-inflation-decelerates-to-9-2-percent-in-july/)
